title: Endurance

slides.title: 6 MEN. A 7-METRE BOAT. THE WILDEST OCEAN ON EARTH.

slides.text: 28 men escaped the ice and reached Elephant Island. But nobody would ever come looking for them there.
Shackleton's plan: take 5 men in one lifeboat, the James Caird, and sail 1,300 km (800 miles) to South Georgia for help.
The Southern Ocean has some of the biggest waves on the planet. And they had to find one small island in the middle of it.
Their navigator, Frank Worsley, could only see the sun a handful of times. One mistake and they would miss the island and be lost at sea.
Sea spray froze onto the boat until it was heavy enough to sink them. They crawled out and chipped the ice off by hand.
After more than two weeks, they saw land. South Georgia.

But storms forced them onto the wrong side of the island. The whaling station, and help, was on the other side, across mountains nobody had ever crossed.
Part 4: the finale.

caption: The most dangerous boat trip ever attempted: 1,300 km across the Southern Ocean in an open lifeboat, steering by the sun they could barely see. Endurance, part 3 of 4.
